services.name: Teacher Training
services.desc: Founded by Ory Avni, Body & Flow offers a variety of educational courses and workshops with an emphasis on supporting students in becoming thoughtful, confident, responsible, and compassionate leaders in the movement community. Ory has over 20 years of teaching experience, and has been inspiring movement teachers worldwide through Body & Flow since 2008. Recognizing that outstanding teachers require confidence in how to teach as much as in what to teach, Ory developed Body & Flow to foster future educators who excel in decision making, critical thinking, and adaptability.
